name: 室生寺五重塔
checkpoints: Exactly FIVE diminishing roof levels, square three-bay lower storey, red columns and white infill.
Fine kokera wood-shingle roof layers, upper finial with nine rings and distinctive canopy and vase ornament; do not replace it with a standard flame-shaped pagoda finial.
Include the small platform and only short base lines, remove forest and the long foreground stone stairway.
